tools.name: generate_image

Runs as a job: the call waits up to about two minutes and returns the result; if it is not ready by then it returns the generation with status queued/running —

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video clip for the title. Duration is the main cost driver, and some models bill a minimum length even when the clip is shorter — estimate first. ASYNC: returns a job with an id and status — poll get_video for the result.

tools.name: generate_audio
tools.description: Generate speech (text-to-speech) for the title. Billed per character. The voice comes from the tier's model unless you pass one in params. Runs as a job: the call waits up to about two minutes and returns the result; if it is not ready by then it returns the generation with status queued/running — p

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate music (a loop or a short track) for the title. A different vendor path and a different price from generate_audio, which is speech. Runs as a job: the call waits up to about two minutes and returns the result; if it is not ready by then it returns the generation with status queued/running —

tools.name: generate_three_d
tools.description: Generate a 3D asset (mesh) for the title. ASYNC: returns a job with an id and status — poll get_three_d for the result.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Poll a video job by id. While it runs the status says so; when it is done the CDN URL is in Assets.

tools.name: get_three_d
tools.description: Poll a 3D job by id. When it is done the model CDN URL is in Assets.

tools.name: remix_video
tools.description: Remix an existing video job with new instructions. Starts a new job — poll get_video. ASYNC: returns a job with an id and status — poll get_video for the result.

tools.name: list_ai_tiers
tools.description: List the quality/price tiers available on this publisher's plan for every kind of media, and — for each tier — the settings its model accepts: field keys, allowed values, defaults and what they do. That list is the reference for the `params` argument of the generate_* tools. Read-only and free.

tools.name: estimate_media_cost
tools.description: Estimate what a generation will cost in credits before running it. Read-only and free. exact=true means computed from the model's price list; approximate=true means the vendor names the final sum itself (video and music) and the number is a best guess; both false means there is nothing to estimate f

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Read a generation by id: its status (queued | running | completed | failed), the CDN URLs in Assets or the text in OutputText when it is done, the error when it failed. Poll it for generations that returned queued/running. Read-only and free.

tools.name: generate_text
tools.description: Generate text via AI (copy, item descriptions, dialogue). Runs as a job: the call waits up to about two minutes and returns the generated text; if it is not ready by then it returns the generation with status queued/running — poll get_generation with its id. tools.name: get_localization_keys

Write ONLY the default language: other locales are filled by trans

tools.name: publish_cloud_code
tools.description: Publish server-side game logic (CloudCode) and make it live. This is the only way to run custom code on the server, and the only way to write protected data: the ReadOnly/Internal buckets of a player's UserCustomData and the Runtime scope of the title's data store. The script is plain JavaScript fil

tools.name: list_kanban_projects
tools.description: List the publisher's task boards (projects) with their names and progress. Start here: every other kanban tool needs a project_id.

tools.name: get_kanban_board
tools.description: Read a board: its columns and the cards in them. Cards come back COMPACT — key, title, priority, assignee, due date, labels and counters, without descriptions or checklists. Call get_kanban_card for the full text of one card.

tools.name: get_kanban_card
tools.description: Read ONE card in full: description, checklist, links, watchers, estimate and which column it sits in. Address it either by card_id or by its human key like OPUS-451.

tools.name: search_kanban_cards
tools.description: Find cards ACROSS all the publisher's boards by a substring of the title or by the task key. Two characters minimum; archived boards are excluded.

tools.name: get_my_kanban_tasks
tools.description: Cards assigned to a person across all boards, soonest deadline first. Defaults to the publisher who owns this connection — pass assignee_id for a teammate.

tools.name: get_kanban_comments
tools.description: Read the comment thread of a card, oldest first.

tools.name: list_kanban_members
tools.description: Who can be assigned a card, watch it or be mentioned: the publisher and the teammates with kanban access. Returns ids and emails — use the id for set_kanban_assignee.

tools.name: create_kanban_card
tools.description: Add a card to a column. The server assigns the human key (OPUS-451) — it is in the reply.

tools.name: update_kanban_card
tools.description: Change a card's title, description, priority or deadline. Fields you leave out stay as they are — this is a patch, not a replacement.

tools.name: move_kanban_card
tools.description: Move a card to another column (or to another position in the same one). Moving it into a done column also completes the task and awards its XP; moving it back out clears the completion mark. The reply says which happened.

tools.name: set_kanban_assignee
tools.description: Assign a card to someone, or clear the assignee. The person is notified.

tools.name: delete_kanban_card
tools.description: Delete a card. IRREVERSIBLE, and its task key is never reused — ask the publisher before calling this. To take a card off the board without losing it, move it instead.

tools.name: add_kanban_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a card. It appears under the publisher's own name, so write as the assistant, not as them. Mentioned people are notified.

tools.name: create_kanban_project
tools.description: Create a board. It comes with a default set of columns, so you can add cards right away.

tools.name: update_kanban_project
tools.description: Rename a board, change its description/icon/colour, or archive it. Archiving hides it from search and from my-tasks without deleting anything.

tools.name: delete_kanban_project
tools.description: Delete a whole board with every card, comment and attachment on it. IRREVERSIBLE and there is no undo — ask the publisher first, and prefer archiving via update_kanban_project(archived=true), which is reversible.

tools.name: create_kanban_column
tools.description: Add a column to a board.

tools.name: update_kanban_column
tools.description: Rename a column, recolour it, or mark it as the done column. Cards entering a done column count as completed and award XP.

tools.name: delete_kanban_column
tools.description: Delete a column TOGETHER WITH EVERY CARD IN IT. IRREVERSIBLE — ask the publisher first, and move the cards out with move_kanban_card if they should survive.

tools.name: reorder_kanban_columns
tools.description: Set the left-to-right order of the columns. Pass every column id of the board.

tools.name: begin_build_upload
tools.description: Start uploading a READY web build of the game (static files: index.html + assets — e.g. Vite dist/, Unity WebGL) to a Title. Returns build_id, a one-hour upload_url and asset_base. tools.name: finish_build_upload
tools.description: Finish an upload started with begin_build_upload: unpacks the zip into a new version of the Title (it appears in the dashboard's version history) and waits up to ~100 s. Returns the version with a TestUrl to try it before players see it. deploy=true also puts it live for players on the Title's addre

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: State of one version of the Title's game: status (Queued, Building, Staged = ready to deploy, Live, Failed), errors, test and live links. Use it to poll finish_build_upload.

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: Recent versions of the Title's game, newest first — uploaded ones and ones built by the AI Coder — with which one players get now.
